_README: H18 — the Baton Pass bias cell. A COPY of designs/ops/anchors.json with exactly three
changes, so the committed config is never edited:
1. opponents.metamon.cache_dir -> a SHADOW cache (symlinks to the real one) that also
holds the `bp_enriched` team set: the 20 Baton-Pass-carrying pool teams drawn by
3. our_team_sources.home -> the SAME 20 files as a dir, so both sides draw the same set
and `team_source_asymmetry` can see any residual mismatch. They are the pool's own
EXPORTED pastes (complete Hidden Power IV lines, nickname-free) — hazards H2/H3.
opponents.metamon.python is DELIBERATELY a path that does not exist: the arm is chosen by
$GEN3AI_METAMON_PYTHON, and a cell launched without it must REFUSE by name rather than
quietly run the installed (unpatched) interpreter. That exact slip happened once here.
